about: Retail Quake Live wire-contract enum values that are not stored as string tables in the retail binaries. Each group cites its evidence; scripts/check_wire_contract.py requires FnQL-game's headers to match. HLIL references are to QuakeLive-SRP/references/hlil/quakelive/.

powerup_t.evidence: qagamex86 quad multiplier reads ps.powerups[4] (0x1006f2a9); flight thrust drives powerups[9] (0x1002fa80); cgamex86 draws spawn armor, quad, battlesuit, invis, regen, frozen from entityState.powerups bits 0,4,5,7,8,15 (0x10041860) and invulnerability, scout, guard, doubler, armor regen from bits 10..14 (0x1004259f..0x10042776); IT_POWERUP/IT_TEAM giTags in retail bg_itemlist.

holdable_t.evidence: IT_HOLDABLE giTags in retail bg_itemlist (teleporter 1, medkit 2, kamikaze 3, portal 4, invulnerability 5, flight 6); flight thrust checks giTag 6 (qagamex86 0x1002fac9).

persistantPowerup_t.evidence: IT_PERSISTANT_POWERUP giTags in retail bg_itemlist; damage multiplier compares stats[STAT_PERSISTANT_POWERUP] with 3 for the doubler (qagamex86 0x1006f2a9).

armorTier_t.evidence: IT_ARMOR giTags in retail bg_itemlist (body 1, combat 2, jacket 3, shard 4).

healthTier_t.evidence: IT_HEALTH giTags in retail bg_itemlist (mega 1, large 2, medium 3, small 4).

keyMask_t.evidence: IT_KEY giTags in retail bg_itemlist; target_remove_keys tests bits 1, 2, 4 of stats[15] (qagamex86 0x10066ff0).

weapon_t.evidence: IT_WEAPON giTags in retail bg_itemlist; retail cgame weapon table order.

pmtype_t.evidence: Retail pmove type name table (retail_tables.json pmTypes).

pm_flags.evidence: PMF_TIME_WATERJUMP: retail PM_CheckWaterJump ORs 0x80 (qagamex86 0x1002f814); PMF_USE_ITEM_HELD 0x400 tested by flight thrust (0x1002fac9). Remaining Quake Live bits are verified with movement parity (milestone 3).

statIndex_t.evidence: stats[1] holdable item index and stats[9], [11], [12] flight thrust, fuel and recharge (qagamex86 0x1002fa80); stats[2] persistant powerup tag (0x1006f290); stats[15] key mask (0x10066ff0).

configstrings.evidence: Retail qagame SetConfigstring/GetConfigstring call sites (imports 25/26): music 2, message 3, warmup 5, scores 6/7, vote 8..11, game version 12 "baseqz" (0x1006648d), level start 13, intermission 14 (0x10056ce4), items 15, award leaders 16, models 17, sounds 273 (0x111+i), players 529 (0x211+i), locations 593 (0x251 "unknown", 0x10067be5), flag status 658 (0x292, 0x10068842).

entity_event_t.evidence: Event names printed by retail CG_EntityEvent (cgamex86 0x10019EB0) for each value 0..99; slots 36, 52 and 91 are unused.

entityType_t.evidence: Quake III Team Arena layout, unchanged in Quake Live; the FnQL engine snapshot code relies on ET_EVENTS for retail modules.

team_t.evidence: Quake III layout; team flag items use TEAM_RED 1 / TEAM_BLUE 2 ordering throughout retail Team_ code.

persEnum_t.evidence: qagamex86 writes ps.persistant (gclient +0x100 + 4*i): PERS_HITS [1] +=/-= in G_Damage (0x100494b7), PLAYEREVENTS [5] ^= 4 (0x10047074), PERS_ATTACKER [6] = attacker (0x100496f3), [7] += 1 on death (0x1004750c), [8] with "impressive" (0x1003fd15, railgun 0x1006e1ac), [9] "excellent" (0x1003fcf4), [10] "defend" (0x1003fd57), [11] "assist" (0x1003fd78), [12] "gauntletaward" (0x1003fd36), [13] captures (0x1004aae1, 0x1006a7bf), [14] killing blows in G_Damage (0x100499d1). Quake Live dropped Team Arena's PERS_ATTACKEE_ARMOR, so the award counters sit one index lower. PERS_RANK, PERS_TEAM and PERS_SPAWN_COUNT keep the Quake III order around the observed slots (inference).

spawnGametypeTokens.evidence: Token switch of the retail gametype-list parser used by the "gametype"/"not_gametype" spawn keys (qagamex86 0x1002d870); token i selects bit i+1.
